'''Weren Dal''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Weren Dal was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the Clone Wars. Near the end of the war, Dal was flying a [[Delta-6 Sprite-class starfighter|Delta-6]] when she was shot down by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] over [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] under the orders of Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Teaok/Legends|Teaok]].<ref name="SS" />

Crash landing in the northern region of the world below, Dal survived the initial crash but was severely injured. Taking her [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] with her, Dal located a nearby cave to take shelter in. Constructing a cot to sleep on, Dal died in the cave. Her damaged [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] remained at her side, along with the disassembled droid and a lock box containing its memory core.<ref name="SS" />
